sources.quote: APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
An approval covers the named manufacturing location only.
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).

findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL is for Alluminio B at Settimo Torinese. The proposed source is Alluminio B's Rovereto plant, which is a different manufacturing location. The ASL is the complete list for this part, plant and customer, so Rovereto has no approval. The 6082-T6 grade is the same, but that does not extend the approval to another location.
